summary: Starlink AI Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration statement and the consummation of its IPO on May 11, 2026. It sold 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, each consisting of one ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of an ordinary share upon an initial business combination, generating $100M in gross proceeds. The underwriter is A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The trust agreement and sponsor letter are filed. As a pre-business-combination SPAC, the event is its IPO. Watch for subsequent de-SPAC target announcement and shareholder vote risk.
